acceptanceCriteria: let_it_be and let!/let seeding, include_context/shared_context bodies (same-file and resolvable cross-file), and factory definitions with associations/traits are read into the seed shape, with counts of implicit associated records.
Measured on one real Rails suite: share of linked pairs analysed before vs after; unresolved forms still abstain.
body: Residual from V1-1883 (PR #1178, spec non-goals). let_it_be, shared_context/include_context and factory definitions/associations (implicit associated records) give not-analysed or are not read, so most real Rails suites abstain.
title: Seed parity: read let_it_be, shared contexts and factory definitions/associations so real suites stop abstaining
